title: 1955 AHSME Problem 31
statement: An equilateral triangle whose side is \(2\) is divided into a triangle and a trapezoid by a line drawn parallel to one of its sides. If the area of the trapezoid equals one-half of the area of the original triangle, the length of the median of the trapezoid is:

solutions.text:
The small triangle also has half the original area. If its side parallel to the original base has length \(b,\) similarity gives \[ \left(\frac b2\right)^2=\frac12, \] so \(b=\sqrt2.\) The parallel sides of the trapezoid have lengths \(2\) and \(\sqrt2,\) so its median has length \[ \frac{2+\sqrt2}{2}. \]

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: The small triangle has half the original area, so determine its side using similarity
The trapezoid median is the average of its two parallel side lengths
